description: This file defines an Angular component 'NoteDetailComponent' which displays the details of a note, allowing editing, deletion, and navigation actions. It manages internal state for showing an edit form and emits events to parent components.

classes.name: NoteDetailComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that displays detailed information about a note and provides editing, deletion, and navigation controls.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called upon component initialization, currently empty.

methods.name: enableEdit
methods.description: Enables editing mode by setting showEdit to true.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles the update of a note, emits the 'edit' event and hides the edit form.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Emits the delete event with the note's ID to request deletion.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Emits the back event to navigate back to previous view.
